title: Running time of unary token encoding
statement: The specified finite Turing machine computes, on every Boolean string $x$, the encoding of the token and remainder obtained by splitting off the maximal leading block of true bits together with its terminating false bit, or the entire string if there is no false bit. Its running time on an input of length $n$ is $3(n+1)$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: The input is any Boolean string
The time bound is evaluated at the input length
